name: meridian-internal-tools-portal
description: Proof of concept: internal tools as normal code (FastAPI + React/TS).

scripts.setup: cd backend && (test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt -e ../packages/platform/python && cd .. && npm install && npm run gen:api
scripts.gen:api: cd backend && .venv/bin/python scripts/export_openapi.py && cd .. && npm run gen:api --workspace frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
